description_en: Queries the namespaces in an Alibaba Cloud Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster
description_zh: 查询阿里云K8S容器服务（ACK）集群命名空间
name: DescribeAckClusterNamespaces

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the ACK cluster connector. To obtain this ID, call the [DescribeAckClusterConnectors](~~DescribeAckClusterConnectors~~) operation.

- [DescribeAckClusterConnectors](~~DescribeAckClusterConnectors~~): Queries a list of ACK cluster connectors
parameters.help_zh:
ACK集群连接器ID。取值来源：
- [DescribeAckClusterConnectors](~~DescribeAckClusterConnectors~~)：批量查询ACK集群连接器列表
parameters.name: connector_id
